# Doing Nothing (doingnothing.lol)
> The viral satire micro-SaaS where an unemployed founder proudly does nothing, and visitors buy him meals to get featured on a public daily leaderboard.

## Site Summary
- Website: https://doingnothing.lol
- Brand: doingnothing.lol
- Tagline: Unemployed since 2026. Proud of it.
- Description: A transparent, viral humor and community leaderboard project where visitors voluntarily fund meals for the founder in exchange for public leaderboard spotlight, custom link placement, and social bragging rights.
- Business Model: Voluntary pay-what-you-want patronage starting at $1. Leaderboard rankings reset every 24 hours at midnight UTC.
- Key Value: Top donor gets the golden crown and permanent Hall of Fame bragging rights.

## Key Pages & URL Map
- [Home & Leaderboard](https://doingnothing.lol/): Live daily leaderboard, current collection stats, meal status, and the dodging "Go get a job" button.
- [About & Manifesto](https://doingnothing.lol/about): The manifesto, founder background, rules of doing nothing, and complete FAQ.
- [Rules & Guidelines](https://doingnothing.lol/rules): Pin tiers table, contribution guidelines, reset schedule, and link policy.
- [Hall of Fame](https://doingnothing.lol/hall-of-fame): The all-time greatest patrons, biggest spenders, and legendary supporters in Doing Nothing history.
- [Don't Press](https://doingnothing.lol/dont-press): The infamous interactive red button that counts clicks and tests user self-control.
- [Get Roasted](https://doingnothing.lol/get-roasted): Instant satirical roaster for startups, tech products, handles, and side projects.
- [Stillness Challenge](https://doingnothing.lol/challenge): The Stillness Challenge measuring how long visitors can stay completely still without moving cursor or touching keys.
- [Procrastination Excuses](https://doingnothing.lol/excuses): Realistic workplace and productivity excuse generator for professional procrastinators.
- [Soundboard](https://doingnothing.lol/soundboard): Quirky soundboard featuring classic internet sound effects and funny noises.
- [Privacy Policy](https://doingnothing.lol/privacy): Privacy policy: zero selling of personal data, minimal analytics, no tracking cookies.
- [Terms of Service](https://doingnothing.lol/terms): Terms of service: voluntary meal gifts, safe-for-work links only.

## Leaderboard Contribution Tiers
- Legend: $100+ (Golden crown badge, #1 spotlight, permanent Hall of Fame entry)
- Big Spender: $25+ (Purple badge, prominent card listing)
- Supporter: $5+ (Green badge, standard card)
- Noodle Fan: $1+ (Credited on daily board)
